description: Run Langflow (official image) in Docker bound to loopback 127.0.0.1:7860. Reaches host Ollama via host.docker.internal — set the Ollama component Base URL to http://host.docker.internal:11434 (no cloud key).

steps.description: Make sure the AI Chat plugin's Ollama is running on 127.0.0.1:11434 (start it if installed). Install the AI Chat plugin first if this reports it missing.
steps.run: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; if command -v ollama >/dev/null 2>&1; then export OLLAMA_HOST=127.0.0.1:11434; nohup ollama serve >/tmp/ollama.log 2>&1 & for i in $(seq 1 20); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/version >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 1; done; fi; echo "Ollama not reachable on 127.0.0.1:11434 — install/run the AI Chat plugin first (it sets up Ollama with no root)."

steps.description: Start the Langflow container bound to loopback 127.0.0.1:7860 (data in the Docker volume "langflow").
steps.run: docker rm -f langflow 2>/dev/null || true; docker run -d --name langflow --restart unless-stopped -p 127.0.0.1:7860:7860 --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway -v langflow:/app/.langflow langflowai/langflow:latest

steps.description: Wait for Langflow to start (first run runs DB migrations).
steps.run: for i in $(seq 1 90); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:7860/health >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 2; done; echo "Langflow still starting — give it a moment."

uninstall.description: Stop and remove the Langflow container and its data volume.
uninstall.run: docker rm -f langflow 2>/dev/null || true; docker volume rm langflow 2>/dev/null || true
